other_conditions: Must be an outstanding superannuated teacher or scientist with a minimum of 5 years of teaching/research experience.
Must be at the level of Principal Scientist/Professor or equivalent.
Must be retired or set to retire within the next 12 months.
Maximum age for application is 65 years; can work up to age 70 or for three years, whichever is earlier.

Must have at least 5 refereed research papers in the last five years, or have received a national/international award, or for teachers, have national/university teaching excellence awards or appreciation letter.
Project proposal must be of national importance and no regular scientist of equal competence is available in the institute.
Must work under the executive authority where the proposal is submitted and attach to an agricultural university or ICAR institute.
Must not hold any other regular or part‑time remunerative job during the tenure.
Must not receive financial assistance for the same work from any other source while receiving Council assistance.
benefits_summary: Recipients receive an honorarium of Rs. 50,000 per month plus a contingent grant of Rs. 2,00,000 per annum and allowances for research support.
documents_required: Prescribed application proforma (15 copies) submitted to the Deputy Director General (Education), ICAR
Recommendation/justification from the executive authority where the work will be carried out
